metadata.name: skill-dev-flow
metadata.description: SKILL development flow: Triage → Design → SKILL Dev → Parallel[Go Dev + Frontend Dev] → Integration → QA → Terminal
metadata.author: team-flow

skills.description: Create and refine v3 flow JSON definitions
Execute v3 flows by running flow proc run

nodes.name: Triage
nodes.description: Classify incoming task, dispatch to appropriate sub-flow, and handle verification failures from downstream roles

docs.name: TASK_CLASSIFICATION
docs.description: Task classification and dispatch decision record
content_rules: Must contain: task summary, classification type (skill/go-backend/frontend/integration/rejected), reasoning, target node
Must explain: why this classification was chosen over alternatives
For verification failures: must include failure details from downstream, retry count, and next action decision
Loop Guard: must track retry count for same task to same node (max 3)

nodes.name: SKILL Architecture
nodes.description: Design SKILL structure: flow nodes, roles, rules, and prompt templates. Verify upstream requirements before designing.

docs.name: SPEC
docs.description: SKILL specification with flow structure, role definitions, and rule design
content_rules: Must contain: Overview, Roles table, Flow structure, Rules list, Gates definition
Each role must have: id, name, alias, alias_en, persona summary
Flow structure must show: node IDs, types, edges, role assignments
Rules must list: id, instruction, enforcement level
Define what deliverable docs this skill will use: name, format, purpose, structure
Interactive with user to confirm doc structure before implementation

docs.name: AC
content_rules: Must contain: acceptance criteria as testable assertions
Each criterion must be verifiable (pass/fail)
Must cover: flow validation, role completeness, rule enforcement, doc deliverables

docs.name: VERIFY_REPORT
content_rules: Must contain: what was checked, result (pass/fail), evidence
Must verify: SPEC structure completeness, role definitions, rule clarity
Must verify: AC is testable and covers all aspects

nodes.name: SKILL Implementation
nodes.description: Implement SKILL.md, flow JSON, and prompt templates based on architecture. Verify upstream SPEC before implementing.

docs.name: FLOW_JSON
content_rules: Must pass: flow proc validate with zero errors
Must contain: metadata, components (roles, rules), nodes, edges
Each node must have: id, type, name, role assignment
Role IDs must match components.roles definitions
Rule IDs must match components.rules definitions
Path variables must use {DOCS_INTERNAL} not {docs_path}

docs.name: SKILL_MD
content_rules: Must contain: Purpose, Core Principle, Status Line, Session Startup Protocol
Must reference: exec skill for execution protocol
Must define: how AI should load and follow the flow
Version must match flow JSON version

docs.name: SKILL_TEMPLATES
content_rules: Create templates based on SPEC's doc definitions
Templates are part of this skill (not task deliverables)
Each template file should be tailored to the skill's domain
Templates should have clear placeholders and instructions
Template filenames should match doc names in flow JSON

docs.name: VERIFY_REPORT
content_rules: Must contain: what was checked, result (pass/fail), evidence
Must verify: upstream SPEC completeness and executability
Must verify: flow proc validate passes, SKILL.md is self-contained

nodes.name: Parallel Development
nodes.description: Run Go backend and frontend development concurrently after SKILL implementation

nodes.name: Go Backend Implementation
nodes.description: Implement Go backend: CLI commands, flow engine, proc runtime changes. Verify upstream deliverables before coding.

docs.name: IMPLEMENTATION
content_rules: Must contain: Files changed, Key decisions, Deviations from SPEC
Each change must list: file path, what was added/modified/removed
Must note any deviations from the original SPEC design

docs.name: VERIFY_REPORT
content_rules: Must contain: what was checked, result (pass/fail), evidence
Must verify: upstream FLOW_JSON validity, SKILL.md completeness
Must verify: go build passes, go test passes

nodes.name: Frontend Implementation
nodes.description: Implement frontend: flow editor, visualization, UI components. Verify upstream deliverables before coding.

docs.name: FRONTEND_CHANGES
content_rules: Must contain: Components changed, Props/State changes, Style changes
Each component must list: file path, what was modified
Must note any UX impact or breaking changes

docs.name: VERIFY_REPORT
content_rules: Must contain: what was checked, result (pass/fail), evidence
Must verify: upstream implementation notes, API contracts
Must verify: bun run build passes

nodes.name: Integration
nodes.description: Integrate SKILL + Go + Frontend changes, verify end-to-end. Verify upstream verification reports before integrating.

docs.name: INTEGRATION_REPORT
content_rules: Must contain: Test results, Integration points verified, Issues found
Each test must show: test name, pass/fail, details if failed
Must verify: flow proc validate, flow proc run, flow proc rule all work

docs.name: VERIFY_REPORT
content_rules: Must contain: what was checked, result (pass/fail), evidence
Must verify: upstream VERIFY_REPORTs are credible and complete
Must verify: end-to-end integration passes

nodes.name: Quality Gate
nodes.description: Independent final verification: SKILL evaluation (skill-creator methodology), Go tests, frontend build, integration. Do NOT trust self-check reports.

docs.name: QA_REPORT
docs.description: QA verification report covering all layers + SKILL evaluation
content_rules: Must contain: SKILL Evaluation, Compilation check, API verification, Frontend check, E2E results
SKILL Evaluation section must follow skill-creator methodology: test prompts → run → evaluate → benchmark
Each layer must show: what was tested, pass/fail, evidence
Must include: flow proc validate result, go test result, lint result
Must independently verify key deliverables (not trust self-check reports)
SKILL evaluation must check: SPEC alignment, rule completeness, node coverage, doc quality
On failure: report specific failure details and suggested fix to principal
